backlog.title: Scorpio Stops Calling It Love When Family Grief Becomes ‘Your Problem’
backlog.hook: Scorpio handled the hospital, the paperwork, and the grief. Their partner called it ‘your problem.’
backlog.angle: Scorpio | Single AI host | A family crisis exposes the difference between respecting someone’s private grief and refusing to share any emotional or practical load. Keep the conflict behavioral; no medical advice or destiny claim.
